subject: a walnut-shell moss garden
pose: shell angled to reveal its interior
art_direction: 半枚核桃壳里长着一小片苔藓和弯枝，像掌心大小的安静小岛。
visible_description: 半枚核桃壳里长着一小片苔藓和弯枝，像掌心大小的安静小岛。
composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Create a miniature moss garden inside half a walnut shell, with one curved twig and a single smooth pale pebble. Angle the shell to reveal its interior without turning it into a landscape panorama. Render fine shell grooves and soft moss fibers. Diffuse warm light on a muted ivory background makes the small object feel intimate and carefully tended. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
